data.body: [P2] Journal service retries through `record_service_attempt`. `record_attempt` adds `launchedAtMs` regardless of the `source` diagnostic. Adjudication therefore treats these service-initiated requests as client launches that must appear in frozen observations. A retry first discovered during release or retirement incorrectly produces `INCOMPLETE: frozen observations do not cover all client-journaled launches`, even with valid retirement evidence. Use `record_service_attempt` with the original request identity so these entries receive `discoveredAtMs`, and test a retry discovered after observations freeze.
